entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Alex, I'm calling about this ridiculous jersey you sent me. I ordered a large and it's so tight I can barely get it on. This is completely unacceptable!

I'm very sorry to hear about the issue with the sizing. I can definitely look into that for you. Just to clarify, is the problem that it's the wrong size, or is there some kind of defect with the fabric?
Are you listening to me? It's the wrong size! It's too tight! What kind of a question is that? I want this fixed right now, or I'm writing a review that will sink your company. Get me your manager!

I understand your frustration, and I assure you I can handle this for you without needing a manager. Getting the right fit is crucial for a good ride. I just need to pull up your account. Could you please provide me with your order number?
Ugh, fine. It's VF-8675309. You better be able to do something. I want an exchange for a jersey that actually fits.

Thank you. Let me see... Okay, I see your order was delivered just four days ago. The jersey is covered by our 90-day return policy, so we can absolutely process an exchange for a larger size or a full refund. It's your choice.
Oh. Well, why didn't you just say that? I want the exchange. Obviously.

Of course. I can start that exchange process for you right now. I'll have a pre-paid return label sent to your email. Once you drop the current jersey off, we will ship out the new size immediately. Does that sound good?
Yeah, fine. Just make sure you send the right one this time.
I've just processed it for you. The return label should be in your inbox shortly. I do apologize again for the inconvenience with the sizing. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit and have a great day.
